say:1:1121122001:1.text: Good day, sir. Are you here to investigate the case? I have some information.
say:1:1121122001:1.male: Good day, sir. Are you here to investigate the case? I have some information.
say:1:1121122001:1.female: Good day, miss. Are you here to investigate the case? I have some information.

say:2:1121122002:1.text: I didn't see anything, but my wife did. We were taking a stroll around the square when she suddenly told me she saw a <style="highlight">purplish-red light</style>.
say:2:1121122002:1.source_cn: 事实上，不是我，是我太太。当时我们正在广场周边散步，她...

say:3:1121122003:1.text: She said the light was extremely... It looked solid and sticky for some reason.
say:3:1121122003:1.source_cn: 而且，她表示那光芒异常诡异……明明是光，却给人有实体般...

say:4:1121122004:1.text: As I was trying to calm her down, I turned and found that the statue had disappeared!
say:4:1121122004:1.source_cn: 我正在让她冷静下来的时候，一偏头，就发现女神像不见了！

say:7:1121122006:2.text: ... I can't remember, but there's an indescribable sense of disgust churning in my stomach.
say:7:1121122006:2.source_cn: ……想不起来。不过，有一股难以言喻的厌恶，就像是本能一...

say:8:1121122007:1.text: We also received reports of an abnormal light. We suspected it was directly related to the missing statue, leading us to conclude that magic was at play.
say:8:1121122007:1.source_cn: 异常光芒的目击报告骑士团也零星收到几份，我们怀疑和女神...

say:9:1121122008:1.text: That's why I proposed enlisting your help.
say:9:1121122008:1.source_cn: 然后我提出申请去请你——后面的事情你们都知道了。
say:9:1121122008:1.male: That's why I proposed enlisting your help.
say:9:1121122008:1.female: That's why I proposed enlisting your help.

choice:6:0:1.text: Does that ring a bell, Talene?
choice:6:0:1.male: Does that ring a bell, Talene?
choice:6:0:1.female: Does that ring a bell, Talene?
